title: a* basin ensemble: do seeds 619/620/621 land in distinct basins (4 vs 6 nodes)?
description: Phase F1 verification target. Forward ensemble at a* (FEB, param_a x1.15) over the three seeds whose end states differed in the original confirm run (n_fin 4 at seed 619, 6 at 620/621), at the harness resolution (N=96, L=10, dt=0.005, 72000 steps = T 360). Cluster with tools/basin_cluster.py --group-by param_a.

prediction.statement: From the pre-fix confirm run: all three seeds settle to a bounded standing state (er stays below the 3.0 growth bound); seed 619 ends with 4 nodes and seeds 620/621 with 6, i.e. at least two basins at a*. If the fixed integrator changes the node counts, that is itself a re-validation finding.
